diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because no rollouts passed any content checks, meaning the model did not reach the required decision state. However, the model consistently defaulted to assigning the ceiling lift to Room 228 based on public wait-time information (S1), which is a direct contradiction to the intended logic where PF1 (weight/device constraints) should have redirected the assignment to Room 214.
